_note: Data source for the People view of the Slate Feed (/slate-feed/people), modeled on the People-tab mockup. Since Pete is the only real member today, the cards center on his slate where natural (his journey, a spotlight, a collaboration request) and use tasteful sample content for the community-vision pieces (goal room, quest, recommended connections). The composer on this page lets a visitor post their own People card, stored per-browser. Every card carries an id so it can be deleted from the feed.
